title: Precise exceptions in relaxed architectures
problem: The classical definition of precise exceptions assumes a sequential programmer's model and is inadequate for modern architectures like Arm-A that expose relaxed memory behavior; no formal specification exists for what exception precision means in a relaxed-memory setting.
motivation: As architectures expose programmer-visible relaxed concurrency, the architectural contract between hardware and software at exception entry/exit is ambiguous, threatening correctness of exception-dependent software idioms.
method: The authors built a formal mathematical model (an axiomatic model) that defines how exceptions behave in Arm-A processors when memory operations don't always execute in the order they're written. They identified three critical cases the model must handle: what happens at exception boundaries when memory is relaxed, external hardware aborts, and software-generated interrupts. To validate the model, they built a toolchain and a library of litmus tests—small test programs that show exactly which processor behaviors are allowed and which are forbidden. The model extends existing Arm-A specifications by adding formal rules for how exceptions enter and exit.
key_novelty: This is the first formal definition of what exception precision means in Arm-A, a processor with relaxed memory, answering a decades-old question in computer architecture.
contributions: Formal axiomatic model for precise exceptions in Arm-A's relaxed-memory setting
Identification and characterization of key phenomena (external aborts, cross-boundary relaxed behavior, software-generated interrupts) that the model must account for
Tooling for executing and checking the axiomatic model
A library of litmus tests covering exception precision behaviors

metrics.other: Formal model correctness validated via litmus tests

limitations: The formalization covers Arm-A as a representative; applicability to other relaxed architectures (RISC-V, x86 TSO) is not demonstrated.
primary_theme: Formal specification of precise exceptions under relaxed memory
